lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Addressed the round-1 reviewer WARNING on US-002 (test/dispatch.test.ts): nothing exercised the idleTimeoutMs = IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS default-wiring path in sendKeysVerified/sendKeysWhenIdle, since every existing test injects an explicit idleTimeoutMs (5 or 1_000). Added two tests in the sendKeysWhenIdle describe block: (1) a boundary assertion that IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS === 30_000 and > 5_000; (2) a wiring test that omits idleTimeoutMs entirely, uses a capturePaneFn that always reports busy (never idle), and mocks both Date.now and process.stderr.write (restored in a finally) so the idle-gate's real deadline math can be driven by the injected sleepFn (fakeNow += ms) instead of a real 30s wall-clock wait -- asserts the send-anyway warning text embeds `did not go idle within 30000 ms` (not the old 5000 ms). Runtime stayed ~200ms for the whole file (23 tests). No production code changed: src/tmux/dispatch.ts, IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS, and SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS are untouched, this was pure test-coverage. Raised test/dispatch.test.ts's file-size ceiling 396->458 (actual content.split('\n').length) with a dated _ref entry naming US-R1-001/CAM-358. Full bun run check:all spine (typecheck, test [5148 pass], embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps) passed green after the ceiling raise. Note: US-R1-002 (also filed by the round-1 reviewer, priority 2 in prd.json) is a separate doc-maintenance finding about a stale '5s idleTimeoutMs' claim surviving in patterns.md:646 and test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts:57/102 after the US-002 default was raised to 30s; it was NOT touched by this story (out of scope, this story only addressed the US-R1-001 test-coverage finding) and remains passes:false for the next implementer.
